entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to return something. This VeloBand Cadence Sensor... it's just not working right and I'm very confused.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I think it's broken. The pulse reading seems like total garbage. I honestly don't have time to mess around with apps and settings. It's just too complicated for me.
I see. We do have a technical support team that's excellent at troubleshooting sensor accuracy. It might just be a simple calibration step. Would you be willing to let me transfer you?
Oh no, I don't think so. I really just want money back. I don't want to spend an hour on the phone. Can't you just help me get a refund? I'm so overwhelmed by this.
I understand completely. You just want a simple solution. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility. Can you confirm the full name on the order for me?
Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 20 days ago.
Yes, that's right. Is that a problem? I'm not sure how this all works.
Not a problem at all. I'm just checking our policy here, and it looks like all our items are eligible for return within 90 days. You're well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? So you can just take it back? That's such a relief!

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just box it up, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so easy. I was so worried.
You're very welcome, Alex. We'll process your full refund as soon as we receive the item. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
